matrix_name.name: Poly(phenylene sulfide)
matrix_name.description: PPS granules (Mn 21000, Mw = 48000, melting point is about 285 C) with an average diameter of 200 um. The granules were pretreated by etching, sensitizing and activating before filler deposition.

fillers.name: Silver
fillers.description: Ag nanocrystals deposited on PPS granules via electroless plating, forming a 3D segregated conductive network in the final composite. An in situ Ag-S coordination reaction occurs during hot-pressing.
